name: Input Stage
description: Receives boundary-enriched canonical graph from Agent 03

name: Scoring Stage
description: Assigns STRIDE severity scores and justifications for each data flow

name: Output Stage
description: Emits STRIDE-scored canonical graph to orchestrator

name: Graph Fetcher
description: Retrieves boundary-enriched canonical graph from Agent 03 state; validates schema compliance

name: LLM Prompt Handler
description: Constructs Agent 04 system prompt (0-5 STRIDE scoring rubric) and user prompt (all data flows with trust boundary context); calls LLM

name: STRIDE Applicator
description: Extracts six STRIDE scores (S/T/R/I/D/E) and justification strings from LLM response; applies to each data flow

name: Validation Engine
description: Validates STRIDE scores; checks that each score is integer 0-5; checks that each justification is non-empty text; ensures schema compliance; rejects non-compliant scores

name: State Emitter
description: Serializes STRIDE-scored canonical graph; returns to orchestrator for Agent 05
